notablePrerequisites:
Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Soliton.
description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
